computer.text: A computer in a sandbox in this tab: it borrows this device’s processor and memory, and never reaches anything else on it.
computer.lede: A computer in this tab, apart from this device: it works on the files a task gives it, and reaches only the sites you allow.
computer.engine.shell.text: Files and folders, with the tools that come with them
computer.engine.quickjs.text: Exact calculations, with packages from npm
computer.engine.pyodide.text: Data work, with pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib: about {size} the first time
computer.internet.text: What the computer may reach. It never gets your cookies or your keys.
computer.internet.never: Off, as Approvals says Never for Using the internet.
computer.sites.none: None yet: each new site is asked about first.
computer.registries.text: For a mirror, such as your organization’s. A key stays on this device and goes only to its address.
computer.time.text: Changing it restarts the computer, which stops what it runs.
computer.limits.text: For long commands, and for a mirror at work. Most people never change these.
computer.workspace.text: The files the computer works on when a task has no folder.
computer.workspace.confirm: Delete every file in this project’s workspace?
computer.workspace.kept: Files shown under an answer stay there.
computer.reach.question: Let the computer reach {site}?
computer.relay.text: A relay’s address, for sites that refuse requests from other sites. Empty: directly, through this device’s own proxy.
computer.terminal.text: Run commands on the computer yourself, over the same files as the conversation; your next message says what you ran. {keys} opens it from anywhere.
computer.terminal.refused: Changed elsewhere meanwhile, so not kept: {files}
